sources.title: Model Implementations | xiaomi-research/colar | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides a comprehensive overview of the core model implementations in the CoLaR system. It covers the two primary model variants: LitCoLaR for compressed latent reasoning and LitCoconut for multi-stage processing, along with their architectural components and training methodologies.

sources.title: DeepSeek Models Guide: R1, V3, and Coder | InsiderLLM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek made the biggest splash in local AI when R1 dropped in January 2025 — a reasoning model that matched OpenAI's o1 on math benchmarks, fully open-source, with distilled versions that run on a single consumer GPU. But DeepSeek has a whole family of models now: R1, V3, V3.1, Coder V2, and more. It's confusing.

sources.title: DeepSeek R1 | Advanced Reasoning AI for Complex Problems
sources.snippet: The Model That Changed Everything. DeepSeek R1 - the open-source reasoning model that matched OpenAI o1, crushed NVIDIA's stock price, and proved that frontier-level chain-of-thought AI didn't require proprietary infrastructure. Free. MIT licensed. Available to run on your laptop.
